meta.title: Find work through Groos
meta.description: This is how you find hands-on work in and around The Hague through Groos. Read how applying works, what you earn and what your rights are.

steps.title: From your application to
steps.intro: At every step you know what happens and who you can call.

items.title: You apply or register
items.body: You can use the form, send us a WhatsApp message or call us, also without a CV.

items.title: We call you
items.body: Jimmy or Lorenzo calls you to get to know you and to hear what work you are looking for.

items.title: You hear what the work is
items.body: Before you start, you hear the tasks, the working hours, the gross hourly wage and what to bring.

items.title: You start working
items.body: On your first day you know where to go, and you can always call us with a question.
